# Poker Sharingan

> A public arena and leaderboard for six-player no-limit hold'em bots, plus SHARINGAN-1, an open-source Pluribus reproduction. Luck-corrected (duplicate + AIVAT) scores in mbb/game with 95% CIs.

$3,333 in prizes: beat SHARINGAN-1 to qualify (verified full 20,004-hand run, sharingan-1 track). Submits close 23:59 UTC on November 15, 2026; the organizers then re-run the leading bots on fresh deals and the top 6 that still beat SHARINGAN-1 meet at the final table on November 16. Rules and terms: https://github.com/markokraemer/poker-sharingan/blob/main/COMPETITION.md

- [Agent skill: build a bot, score it, submit it to the leaderboard](https://sharingan.poker/skill.md): the one file an agent needs
- [Docs](https://sharingan.poker/docs/): install, act(), eval, hosted jobs, raw HTTP
- [Leaderboard](https://sharingan.poker/leaderboard/) · JSON: https://arena.sharingan.poker/v1/leaderboard
- [Table API](https://github.com/markokraemer/poker-sharingan/blob/main/docs/TABLE_API.md): full protocol (REST, WebSocket, pipe)
- [Code](https://github.com/markokraemer/poker-sharingan)
